fields.mechanism: Electrostatic discharge protection through conductive polymer coatings
fields.intervention: Application of a thin conductive polymer coating to intraocular lens surfaces to prevent static charge buildup that may cause tissue irritation or inflammation
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in adverse events by preventing electrostatic interactions between the lens and ocular tissues that could lead to inflammation or discomfort
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated aging testing comparing coated and uncoated lenses under various humidity and temperature conditions, measuring charge dissipation rates and tissue response in vitro
fields.mechanism_source_span: Very little data exists on the effects of these treatments, and they have never been tested in combination

fields.mechanism: Passive light manipulation through microstructured surface to enhance tear film stability without active pharmaceutical intervention
fields.intervention: Incorporate precisely engineered microstructures on intraocular lens surface that manipulate light patterns to promote natural tear film distribution and meibomian gland function
fields.expected_effect: Improved tear film stability and reduced inflammation through passive optical effects without introducing pharmaceutical elements
fields.falsification_test: Compare IOLs with different microstructure configurations measuring tear film dynamics, meibomian gland function, and inflammatory markers in patients with dry eye symptoms
fields.mechanism_source_span: Intense pulsed light is a potent treatment for meibomian gland dysfunction. The aim of this study was to test the effects of the combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light on the symptoms and signs of soft contact lens users.

fields.mechanism: Combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light therapy to treat dry eye disease by reducing inflammation and improving meibomian gland function
fields.intervention: Incorporate a slow-release cyclosporine coating on the intraocular lens surface combined with integrated micro-LEDs for periodic pulsed light treatment
fields.expected_effect: Reduced inflammation and improved tear film stability around the intraocular lens, preventing adverse events related to ocular surface irritation
fields.falsification_test: Compare the incidence of adverse events in patients with standard intraocular lenses versus those with the modified lens in a randomized controlled trial
fields.mechanism_source_span: "The aim of this study was to test the effects of the combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light on the symptoms and signs of soft contact lens users."

fields.mechanism: Combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light therapy to address ocular surface inflammation and meibomian gland dysfunction
fields.intervention: Intraocular lens surface coating with nanomicellar cyclosporine and integration of micro-intense pulsed light emitters around the lens edge
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in ocular surface inflammation and improved tear film stability, preventing adverse events without introducing new failure modes
fields.falsification_test: Comparative study in vivo with implanted lenses testing inflammation markers and tear film parameters between standard lenses, cyclosporine-coated lenses, and cyclosporine-coated with IPL-emitting lenses
fields.mechanism_source_span: The aim of this study was to test the effects of the combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light on the symptoms and signs of soft contact lens users.

fields.mechanism: Combination of cyclosporine nanomicellar drops and intense pulsed light therapy to address ocular surface inflammation and meibomian gland dysfunction
fields.intervention: Incorporate a cyclosporine-eluting coating on the intraocular lens surface combined with integrated micro-LEDs for pulsed light therapy targeting meibomian glands
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in ocular surface inflammation and improved tear film stability, preventing adverse events related to dry eye and inflammation
fields.falsification_test: Compare intraocular lenses with and without the cyclosporine coating and micro-LEDs in a randomized clinical trial measuring tear film stability, ocular surface staining, and meibomian gland function over 12 months
fields.mechanism_source_span: The aim of this study was to test the effects of the combination of nanomicellar cyclosporine and intense pulsed light on the symptoms and signs of soft contact lens users
